name: library_catalog_search
description: The optional category and max-price filters were pushed from Python into the SQL WHERE clause so the database returns only matching rows instead of filtering after the fetch.
flaw: The max-price condition is inverted in optimized/main.py: the rewritten query uses 'unit_price_cents >= ?' where the original semantics require rows priced at or below the limit (the original skips rows with unit_price_cents > max_price_cents). The search returns books priced above the requested maximum instead of at or below it, so the result set is wrong whenever a max price is supplied.
